title: Agentic Refactoring: An Empirical Study of AI Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2511.04824v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agentic coding tools, such as OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor, are changing how software is developed. These AI-powered systems function as autonomous teammates capable of planning and executing complex development tasks. Agents have become active participants in refactoring, a key practice for improving internal code quality without altering observable behavior. Despite their increasing adoption, there is little empirical understanding of how agentic refactoring is used in practice, how it compares to human-driven refactoring, and what impact it has on code quality. To address this gap, we present a large-scale study of AI agent-generated refactorings in real-world open-source Java projects, analyzing 51,412 refactoring instances across 12,256 pull requests and 14,998 commits based on the AIDev dataset. translated_title: 智能体重构：对AI编程智能体的实证研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2511.04824v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：诸如OpenAI Codex、Claude Code和Cursor等智能体编程工具正在改变软件开发的方式。这些AI驱动的系统作为自主的队友，能够规划和执行复杂的开发任务。智能体已经成为重构中的积极参与者，而重构是一种在不改变可观察行为的前提下改进内部代码质量的关键实践。尽管智能体重构的应用日益广泛，但目前缺乏关于智能体重构在实践中如何被使用、与人工驱动的重构相比表现如何、以及它对代码质量有何影响的实证理解。为了填补这一空白，我们基于AIDev数据集，对真实开源Java项目中AI智能体生成的重构进行了大规模研究，分析了跨越12,256个拉取请求和14,998次提交的51,412个重构实例。我们发现重构是一种常见且有明确意图的活动，智能体在26.1%的提交中明确以重构为目标……
tldr: 本文基于AIDev数据集对真实开源Java项目中AI编程智能体生成的重构进行了大规模实证研究，分析了51,412个重构实例，首次系统揭示了智能体重构在实际开发中的使用方式、与人工重构的差异及其对代码质量的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a large-scale empirical study of AI agent-generated refactorings in real-world open-source Java projects, analyzing 51,412 refactoring instances from the AIDev dataset to systematically reveal how agentic refactoring is used in practice, how it compares to human-driven refactoring, and its impact on code quality.
